verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU, a hardware component. Exposing an official MCP server for agents to connect to is a software-service axis that does not fit this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows AMD ships an MCP server for this processor: the Ryzen Master and Ryzen AI Software mentions cover tuning and developer tooling, not an MCP endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
